retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: The small building turns out to be an abandoned restaurant specializing in meat on a stick. Karsemine takes a quick look around and judges that the place was only recently abandoned, no more than a week ago. The chalkboard menu out front has been hastily erased and now simply reads “headed south, north wrong”. Inside the group finds a small sink, dishes neatly put away, and a trapdoor leading to a small storage area. Here they only find a jar with a few skewers with old graying meat. Returning outside, Caelynn takes another look at the weather and decides they may not be able to beat the storm north, so they decide to take shelter in the building. Karsemine uses her survival skills to reinfo

Because of their timing leaving the town and their navigation skills, the wagon is able to make it far enough north to just hit the very edge of the storm and only get soaked. They are able to see the sheen of magic as the rain pools up and instead of the usual petrichor the rain smells savory. Karsemine and Caelynn spot a good camping spot on the top of a conical hill. They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove

Karsemine, always keeping a sharp eye on her surroundings, is the first to notice something just off the trail. She picks up an iridescent scale, still warm to the touch. She shows it to Caelynn to make an arcana check, but she can’t tell anything about it. As the group continues up the path the number of scales laying around continues to grow until it becomes obvious something is up ahead. Karsemine becomes very nervous about reaching the top and finding something waiting. While Caelynn creates Good Berries for everyone, Karemine scouts ahead. The top of the hill is again shaped like a giant bowl, just as before, but this time instead of water this bowl is filled with detritus and the horri

After another failed attempt to contact Mirathorn by rockie-talkie, the group decides they need to come up with a plan to contact someone in the city they can trust. After some debate, they decide they should send a message to Professor Tealeaf, assuming the Wizard’s College is the least likely to be affected by anything nefarious happening, and an encoded message to Grobnok in case the message gets intercepted. The group decides on a spoken and written message about the problems they have had contacting the city and for someone there to contact them back. They send off a silver raven knowing that it would take the rest of the day for it to arrive.

- Storm fronts made the first march day tense; we need to plan the next weather roll beat for Session 23. - Hester Mull appeared as a courier encounter; unresolved whether the party trusts the detour offer.
